rows.description: Paper reports final manuscript GWR diagnostics (N=2,840 active observations / 710 active nodes, Model 2 R²=0.8316, adaptive bi-square reported BW=100 m). Repository retains outcome-independent feasibility machinery (Gaussian kernel, tr(S), tr(S'S)). Kept strictly separated.

rows.sourceBoundary: Paper Behavioral Method vs Repository Outcome
rows.description: Paper specifies dwell duration equations (t_base, F_i, t_effective). Static street-view imagery lacks temporal sensor dwell observations. Gated without assigning zero.
Blockology dwell lambda=1.0 is an uncalibrated repository demonstration placeholder. Isolated from active SIM synthesis.
OSM sampling geometry street_node_* IDs and Murray Hill n* IDs occupy distinct namespaces. Implicit spatial proximity joins are prohibited.

rows.sourceBoundary: 180° Team Source vs Orthogonal 90° Paper Protocol
rows.description: Team source verified as bidirectional along-street 180° views. Equivalence to paper orthogonal 90° analytical protocol remains unresolved.
